destination.title: Consistent reductions and higher-dimensional origins
destination.question: Which finite reductions are consistent, which modes can they retain, and when do their solutions have the proposed higher-dimensional interpretation?
destination.summary: Separates consistency, uplift construction, retained matter content and global realizability.

systems: Type II, heterotic and eleven-dimensional supergravity

Generalized-structure classifications apply within their stated hypotheses

A requirement that every effective description be a gauged-supergravity truncation

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Why did a consistent N = 4 gauged-supergravity truncation with a supersymmetric AdS4 vacuum lack a ten-dimensional interpretation using only conventional fluxes and D6/O6 sources?

sources.title: Consistent supersymmetric Kaluza-Klein truncations with massive modes

evidence.text: Can consistent supersymmetric Kaluza–Klein truncations retain the massive breathing-mode multiplet alongside the massless graviton multiplet, and can the resulting lower-dimensional theories generate exact higher-dimensional solutions?

sources.title: Type IIB supergravity on squashed Sasaki-Einstein manifolds

evidence.text: Can type IIB supergravity on general squashed Sasaki–Einstein five-manifolds admit a finite, nonlinear, consistent truncation retaining the massive KK states dual to the universal gauge sector?

sources.title: Consistent truncations around half-maximal AdS$_{5}$ vacua of 11-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Which consistent truncations around eleven-dimensional AdS₅ vacua preserving 16 supercharges yield five-dimensional half-maximal gauged supergravity with vector multiplets, and what restricts their matter content and gaugings?

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Uplift the source system, retain its assumed geometrical Bianchi identity, and change the reduction circle. Map both curvature and signed sources to identify the resulting ten-dimensional RR identity and compare consistency conditions.

sources.title: Consistent supersymmetric Kaluza-Klein truncations with massive modes

evidence.text: Extract masses from quadratic fluctuations around the AdS vacuum and infer dual operator dimensions. For weak G2 reductions, identify an N=1 scalar description using φ=e^v+ih and K=−7 log(φ+φ̄).

sources.title: Type IIB supergravity on squashed Sasaki-Einstein manifolds

evidence.text: Expand fields in the globally defined structure forms η, J and Ω, whose algebra closes under exterior differentiation and Hodge duality. Substitution into ten-dimensional equations removes internal-coordinate dependence, providing the authors' consistency argument.

sources.title: Consistent truncations around half-maximal AdS$_{5}$ vacua of 11-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Generalized USp(4) structures encode the half-maximal vacua. Algebraic constraints and weak-integrability equations express the BPS conditions; constructing their generalized metric recovers the eleven-dimensional background fields and the Toda equation.

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Transform the entire source-inclusive Bianchi identity, rather than the background flux alone. Track the chosen circle, tensor degrees, source signs and geometric domain; then read the transformed torsion term as the geometrical quadratic contribution.

sources.title: Consistent supersymmetric Kaluza-Klein truncations with massive modes

evidence.text: Expand the metric and four-form using the Sasaki–Einstein structure tensors, then substitute into the eleven-dimensional Bianchi identity, four-form equation, and Einstein equations. The authors find that all internal-coordinate dependence drops out.

sources.title: New formulations of D = 10 supersymmetry and D8 - O8 domain walls

evidence.text: Can Type II supergravity be formulated to support explicitly supersymmetric bulk-plus-brane source actions, particularly D8–O8 domain walls, and what do their sourced solutions imply for Romans mass quantization, wall separation and preserved supersymmetry?

sources.title: Laplacian spectrum on a nilmanifold, truncations and effective theories

evidence.text: Which internal differential-form modes must a compactification retain to describe low-energy physics? The paper separates constructing a useful spectral basis from proving that a finite reduction captures every light fluctuation of an interacting background.

sources.title: G-structures and Domain Walls in Heterotic Theories

evidence.text: Which internal SU(3)-structure six-manifolds support heterotic domain walls preserving two supercharges, and do domain walls in previously constructed four-dimensional half-flat mirror compactifications lift to the corresponding ten-dimensional solutions?

sources.title: Exploiting N=2 in consistent coset reductions of type IIA

evidence.text: Can left-invariant type IIA coset reductions be justified as consistent truncations, and can their four-dimensional N=2 structure constrain supersymmetric, nonsupersymmetric and de Sitter vacua, including perturbative string-loop effects?

sources.title: De Sitter space from warped supergravity solutions

evidence.text: What are the higher-dimensional geometries underlying noncompact gauged-supergravity de Sitter vacua and domain walls, and can their noncompact internal spaces support a lower-dimensional gravitational interpretation?

sources.title: Quantization problem in Scherk-Schwarz compactifications

evidence.text: How does lattice choice, equivalently structure-constant quantization, determine whether a flat-group Scherk–Schwarz compactification genuinely breaks supersymmetry and lifts moduli, and whether its left-invariant truncation describes the low-energy spectrum?

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Can KK5 orientations and localized magnetic flux generate useful D-term interactions or supersymmetry breaking? How do the resulting source-inclusive compactifications fit into existing gauged-supergravity and generalized-geometry classifications?

sources.title: Uplifting non-compact gauged supergravities

evidence.text: How can known de Sitter vacua of regular noncompact maximal gauged supergravity be embedded into eleven-dimensional supergravity, including vacua requiring internal flux? The paper seeks a nonlinear metric and three-form ansatz and a generalized-geometric explanation for it.

sources.title: The conformal manifold of S-folds in string theory

evidence.text: What does the explicit type-IIB uplift reveal about the conformal manifold of 3d N=2 S-fold SCFTs, its infinite-distance limit, brane and line observables, and universal large-N partition functions?

sources.title: Halving ISO(7) supergravity

evidence.text: Can half-maximal truncations make dyonic ISO(7) supergravity tractable while retaining its important supersymmetric vacua, and what additional gaugings and AdS extrema arise?

sources.title: M-theory and Type IIA Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: What additional charge sources permit four-dimensional M-theory and conventional type IIA compactifications with internal four-form flux despite supergravity no-go constraints? The paper also assesses a specific massive-IIA proposal for parametrically separated AdS and Kaluza–Klein scales.

sources.title: BPS domain walls from backreacted orientifolds

evidence.text: How does localising parallel orientifold sources change BPS domain walls obtained from smeared no-scale gauged supergravity, including flows away from the potential minimum?

sources.title: Bubbling 1/2 BPS solutions of minimal six-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Can retaining the torus axion remove the obstruction to a consistent four-dimensional bosonic reduction of minimal six-dimensional supergravity and produce a family of half-BPS bubbling AdS₃×S³ geometries?

sources.title: Type IIA AdS(4) compactifications on cosets, interpolations and domain walls

evidence.text: Which six-dimensional cosets with left-invariant strict SU(3) structures support supersymmetric type IIA AdS4 vacua, with or without smeared sources? Can these vacua be connected by supersymmetric domain walls or interpolated to a G2-holonomy lift?

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein Supergravity 2025

evidence.text: What do eleven-dimensional supergravity compactifications, especially round and squashed seven-spheres, teach about surviving supersymmetry, gauge symmetry, vacuum stability, consistent truncations and complete Kaluza–Klein spectra? This is a retrospective review with updates on spectral methods.

sources.title: A cornucopia of AdS$_{5}$ vacua

evidence.text: Which AdS5 critical points occur in five-dimensional maximal SO(6) gauged supergravity, what supersymmetry and scalar stability do they have, and how many can be captured by tractable consistent truncations?

sources.title: M theory / heterotic duality: A Kaluza-Klein perspective

evidence.text: How much of conjectured M-theory/heterotic duality can be exhibited through classical Kaluza–Klein reductions, including scalar cosets, field couplings, charge lattices and Yang–Mills-supported branes?

sources.title: Consistent subsectors of maximal supergravity and wrapped M5-branes

evidence.text: Which sufficient conditions make invariant subsectors of maximal four-dimensional gauged supergravity consistent when the invariance group lies outside the gauge group, and can a new maximal theory encompass wrapped-M5 AdS4 models and their enlarged mass spectra?

sources.title: Universal Kaluza-Klein reductions of type IIB to N=4 supergravity in five dimensions

evidence.text: Can universal consistent type IIB reductions on arbitrary HK4 × S1 and SE5 retain the massive breathing-mode sector, and what five-dimensional supergravity, gauging and AdS vacua result?

sources.title: New (maximal) gauged supergravities

evidence.text: Review how maximal classical gauged supergravities, their vacua, and their consistent higher-dimensional origins can be constructed and classified, with applications to holography.

sources.title: Tri-Sasakian consistent reduction

evidence.text: Can eleven-dimensional supergravity on any seven-dimensional tri-Sasakian manifold admit a universal consistent truncation retaining massive modes, and what four-dimensional gauged supergravity, AdS vacua and subtruncations result?

sources.title: Flux compactifications of string theory on twisted tori

evidence.text: When does a Scherk–Schwarz truncation admit a genuine compact Kaluza–Klein/string realization with a mass gap, and how do flux, gauge-symmetry breaking and duality covariance operate in that realization?

sources.title: Hidden symmetries from extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can higher-dimensional diffeomorphisms normally broken by Kaluza–Klein truncation survive as constrained global transformations that determine lower-dimensional couplings, including R–R completions of known Type IIA NS–NS interactions?

sources.title: Triality and the consistent reductions on AdS$_{3}$ × S$^{3}$

evidence.text: Can SO(4,4) triality generate inequivalent consistent sphere truncations of six-dimensional supergravity, exposing additional AdS3 vacua and their parameter-dependent Kaluza–Klein spectra?

sources.title: On the KKLT Goldstino

evidence.text: Does a consistent truncation admitting conifold deformation introduce additional UV supersymmetry-breaking modes or modify the holographic Ward-identity diagnosis of a goldstino?

sources.title: Supersymmetry-breaking compactifications on Riemann-flat manifolds

evidence.text: How do complete KK spectra encode spontaneous supersymmetry breaking on compact Riemann-flat spin manifolds, what supertrace identities and one-loop potentials follow, and when can the compactifications be related to Scherk–Schwarz truncations?

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein Spectrometry for Supergravity

evidence.text: Can exceptional field theory efficiently determine KK masses and identify the corresponding higher-dimensional fluctuations, including lower-spin sectors mixed by background fluxes, when residual isometries provide little help?

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein Spectrometry from Exceptional Field Theory

evidence.text: How can exceptional field theory compute Kaluza-Klein masses and identify higher-dimensional mass eigenstates around vacua in maximal consistent truncations, including backgrounds with few or no surviving symmetries?

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein spectrometry for ${\rm AdS_{3}}$ vacua

evidence.text: How can exceptional field theory compute bosonic Kaluza–Klein spectra around AdS3 vacua of three-dimensional half-maximal gauged supergravity, including vacua insufficiently constrained by residual supersymmetry?

sources.title: Compactifications of String/M-Theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: How can internal differential-operator spectra relevant to Freund–Rubin masses be organized by symmetry? On compact Euclidean G/H, the universal Laplacian preserves irreducible G harmonic sectors, while isotropy Casimirs act on field components.

sources.title: Compactifications of String/M-Theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which internal geometry and units underlie the spectral branches? The calculation fixes Einstein squashing, Ricci curvature 27/10, and |m|=3/(2sqrt(5)) in dimensionless units, while retaining the flux sign for the later compactification.

sources.title: De-Higgsing in eleven-dimensional supergravity on the squashed S $^{7}$

evidence.text: How do the Sp(1) × Sp(2) singlet modes and their AdS4 fields change between round, left-squashed and right-squashed S7 compactifications, especially through Rarita–Schwinger consistency, de-Higgsing and boundary-condition choices relevant to stability?

sources.title: The complete Kaluza-Klein spectra of $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 and $ \mathcal{N} $ = 0 M-theory on AdS$_{4}$× (squashed S$^{7}$)

evidence.text: Complete the squashed-S7 Kaluza–Klein operator spectra, assign AdS4 masses and energies to the supersymmetric and skew-whiffed compactifications, and determine how boundary conditions affect possible scalar singlet marginal operators.

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein Spectrometry for Supergravity

evidence.text: Linearize the ExFT field equations, evaluate internal derivatives through the embedding tensor and harmonic generators, and diagonalize finite matrices level by level. Tensor equations require Stückelberg gauge fixing and yield first-order equations for topologically massive two-forms.

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein Spectrometry from Exceptional Field Theory

evidence.text: Linearize ExFT equations and replace internal differentiation by dressed harmonic-action matrices T_A. Mass matrices depend on X and T; scalar contributions organize as XX+XT+TT. Diagonalized modes can be mapped back through the ExFT/supergravity dictionary.

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein spectrometry for ${\rm AdS_{3}}$ vacua

evidence.text: Insert linear fluctuations into the reduction ansatz so their remaining internal dependence requires only scalar harmonics. Matrices T encode internal derivatives on harmonics and obey a commutator normalization fixed by the embedding tensor.

sources.title: Compactifications of String/M-Theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: Convert candidate internal spectra to masses and AdS energies, then simplify absolute values only after imposing the source's representation-Casimir threshold. The restriction is algebraic and leaves low-Casimir modes outside this partial analysis.

sources.title: De-Higgsing in eleven-dimensional supergravity on the squashed S $^{7}$

evidence.text: Derive the Rarita–Schwinger consistency condition by gamma contraction and divergence of its eigenvalue equation. Construct vector-spinors from a transverse-traceless Lichnerowicz tensor and the Einstein-squashed Killing spinor; for the squashing singlet the derivative and algebraic constructions are proportional.

sources.title: The complete Kaluza-Klein spectra of $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 and $ \mathcal{N} $ = 0 M-theory on AdS$_{4}$× (squashed S$^{7}$)

evidence.text: Coset harmonic analysis uses the master equation ĎaY=−TaY and −Ď²=Cg−Ch. A universal Laplacian and Casimir expressions for Weyl-tensor action streamline the operator equations.

sources.title: Bootstrap Bounds on Closed Einstein Manifolds

evidence.text: Can associativity and completeness of Laplacian eigenmodes constrain spectra and triple overlaps on closed Einstein manifolds, thereby bounding tree-level Kaluza–Klein masses and cubic interactions?

sources.title: Towards Kaluza-Klein Dark Matter on Nilmanifolds

evidence.text: Determine the scalar Kaluza–Klein spectrum on the compact three-dimensional Heisenberg nilmanifold with general left-invariant metric, use it to assess a numerical spectral method, and construct an exploratory stable KK dark-matter candidate.

sources.title: The spectrum of marginally-deformed $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 CFTs with AdS$_{4}$ S-fold duals of type IIB

evidence.text: Determine the large-N operator spectrum across the N=2 conformal manifold of an N=4 three-dimensional S-fold CFT, and identify global properties of that manifold through its holographic KK spectrum.

sources.title: Laplacian spectrum on a nilmanifold, truncations and effective theories

evidence.text: Which internal differential-form modes must a compactification retain to describe low-energy physics? The paper separates constructing a useful spectral basis from proving that a finite reduction captures every light fluctuation of an interacting background.

sources.title: Compactifications of String/M-Theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: How can one vary the metric on S^7 without changing its topology? An SU(2) instanton twists an S^3 fiber over S^4; lambda scales the fiber contribution while the bundle remains S^7.

sources.title: Charting the conformal manifold of holographic CFT$_2$'s

evidence.text: Which continuous deformations of AdS3×S3×T4 and AdS3×S3×S3×S1 can be constructed uniformly in heterotic and type II supergravity, what are their Kaluza–Klein spectra and perturbative stability properties, and how should their worldsheet and holographic operators be interpreted?

sources.title: Tachyonic Kaluza-Klein modes and the AdS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Does the non-supersymmetric SO(3) × SO(3)-invariant AdS4 vacuum, stable within four-dimensional N = 8 supergravity, acquire perturbative instabilities from higher Kaluza-Klein modes after uplift to eleven dimensions?

sources.title: Spectrum and stability of compactifications on product manifolds

evidence.text: What is the complete linearized spectrum and perturbative stability of Freund–Rubin compactifications when a q-form individually wraps each of N internal Einstein factors, including factors with unequal flux densities?

sources.title: Charge instability of JMaRT geometries

evidence.text: Do JMaRT geometries admit unstable scalar modes carrying nonzero Kaluza–Klein momentum even with zero angular harmonic number, beyond the near-decoupling limit, and can these modes describe charge loss?

sources.title: Compactifications of String/M-Theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can the right-squashed, nonsupersymmetric AdS4 vacuum develop a tadpole instability associated with a global singlet marginal operator (GSMO)? The thesis seeks sufficiently detailed Kaluza–Klein masses to identify elementary or composite fields that could support this mechanism.

sources.title: Six-dimensional supergravity on S**3 x AdS(3) and 2-D conformal field theory

evidence.text: Can representation theory determine supergravity Kaluza–Klein spectra on S³×AdS3 and explain agreement with boundary CFT chiral primaries and the additional states required by the elliptic genus? The paper also investigates less supersymmetric six- and five-dimensional examples.

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein Supergravity 2025

evidence.text: What do eleven-dimensional supergravity compactifications, especially round and squashed seven-spheres, teach about surviving supersymmetry, gauge symmetry, vacuum stability, consistent truncations and complete Kaluza–Klein spectra? This is a retrospective review with updates on spectral methods.

sources.title: Squashed 7-spheres, octonions and the swampland

evidence.text: How do operator spectra on squashed S7 determine AdS4 masses and supersymmetry multiplets, and what do orientation reversal, boundary conditions and singletons imply for the nonsupersymmetric AdS stability question?

evidence.text: Which nonsupersymmetric AdS5×M6 compactifications on positive Kähler-Einstein six-manifolds are stable against linearized bosonic supergravity perturbations, and what do their KK spectrum, M5 nucleation channel and neutral massless scalars imply for possible instabilities?

sources.title: Shadow multiplets in AdS(4) / CFT(3) and the superHiggs mechanism: Hints of new shadow supergravities

evidence.text: Why do Freund–Rubin Kaluza–Klein spectra contain universal long multiplets with rational dimensions, and can the N=3 graviton's massive gravitino shadow be understood through N=4→N=3 super-Higgs breaking? Does its spectrum require a new supergravity formulation?

sources.title: Relative scale separation in orbifolds of S$^{2}$ and S$^{5}$

evidence.text: How much can finite sphere quotients raise the first nonzero invariant scalar-Laplacian eigenvalue, and can increasing the group order produce parametric relative scale separation for S2/SO(3) and S5/SU(3) quotients?

evidence.text: How is the classical Regge growth conjecture realized by massive spin-2 Kaluza–Klein states after dimensional reduction of Einstein gravity, and what restrictions follow for their spectrum and couplings?

evidence.text: Are the seven nonsupersymmetric AdS4 vacua of maximal ISO(7) gauged supergravity stable against higher-dimensional Kaluza–Klein fluctuations after uplift to massive IIA, and how do their stability properties bear on the nonsupersymmetric AdS Swampland Conjecture?
